Container.Name: Gatehouse
Container.Overview: The agent secrets vault. Credentials never leave the vault. Gatehouse is a self-hosted secrets manager built for AI agent harnesses: agents get scoped access, and the vault injects the credential into the upstream call. Gatehouse is single-instance by design (in-memory rate limiting and an in-process event bus). Run one. It is built for a homelab, not a cluster.
Container.Requires: After first start, open the container log (Docker tab, Logs). It prints the generated master key and a one-time bootstrap root token, once. Copy both. The master key must be escrowed somewhere other than this server: if you lose it, the data is unrecoverable. No secrets are needed in this template.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Container Path: /data. Holds the database, the generated master key file, and the bootstrap token file. Back it up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. URL agents should use to reach Gatehouse (onboarding links). Set when behind a reverse proxy or when the Host header is not the address you want. Leave empty to use the request host.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated CIDRs of reverse proxies allowed to set the client IP via X-Forwarded-For. Needed only behind a proxy on another host or Docker network if you use AppRole IP allowlists or auto-approve by IP. Loopback is always trusted.

Config.Name: Proxy allow private
Config.Description: Allow the credential proxy to reach private and LAN addresses. Set to false to enable SSRF blocking if Gatehouse is exposed to the internet.

Config.Name: OAuth issuer
Config.Description: Optional. OIDC issuer URL. Seeds SSO settings on first boot only; afterwards configure SSO in the web UI.

Config.Name: OAuth client ID
Config.Description: Optional. OIDC client ID (first-boot seed only).

Config.Name: OAuth client secret
Config.Description: Optional. OIDC client secret (first-boot seed only).

Config.Name: OAuth redirect URI
Config.Description: Optional. OIDC redirect URI, ending in /v1/auth/sso/callback (first-boot seed only).
